summary: random parameters: input number (upper bound) or list, seed for repeatable pseudo-random results, start (lower bound), and step (default 1).
questions: How do I get the same random value every run for a host?
How do I set a lower bound for random numbers?
How do I generate random numbers in steps of 10?

answer_card.title: random parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (required): a number (top bound) or a list (source of the random element)
- `seed`: make the selection pseudo-random and repeatable
- `start`: bottom bound
- `step` (default 1): increments used between start and end
